jobs.title: Cost Analyst (00611)
jobs.description:
PMA is currently seeking a Cost Analyst for an exclusive assignment to work on a portfolio of high-profile utility projects. Our Cost Analyst position is an excellent entrée into project controls and project management.

The Cost Analyst supports data management, real estate tax administration, financial analysis, and process improvement initiatives. This role leverages analytics, reporting, and AI-driven automation to enhance operational efficiency, support decision-making, and streamline business processes.

### **Organizational Responsibilities**

* Manage real estate tax, financial, and operational data, ensuring accuracy and timely reporting.
* Administer tax processing, payments, appeals support, invoices, and vendor-related activities.
* Analyze large datasets to produce insights, trends, and actionable recommendations.
* Develop Power BI dashboards and reports to improve visibility into key business metrics.
* Drive process improvements through automation, AI-enabled solutions, and workflow enhancements.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to support efficient execution of real estate operations and strategic initiatives.
* Other duties as assigned.

### **Position Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Data Analytics, or a related field.
* 1+ Years of experience in some combination of real estate operations, financial analysis, or cost control.
* Familiarity with real estate taxes and invoicing processes preferred.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to manage and interpret large datasets.
* Proficiency with Power BI or similar visualization platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to improve workflows, optimize data processes, or automate routine tasks.
* Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Strong communication and collaboration abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment.
* Experience with MS Word and PowerPoint preferred.
* An equivalent combination of education, experience, and training that provides the required knowledge, skills, and abilities will be considered in lieu of stated minimum qualifications.

The salary range for this position is $63,136 to $74,185.

A hired employee will be placed within this salary range based on a variety of legitimate business reasons, including but not limited to the individual’s scope of relevant experience and geographic location.

This client maintains a drug-free workplace, which is essential to the health and safety of all employees and is required as a condition of certain federal agency contracts. Accordingly, employees assigned to this client must comply with all applicable drug-free workplace requirements. In addition, some products marketed as “CBD” may contain THC and can result in a positive drug test. A post-offer, pre-employment drug test is a condition of employment for roles assigned to this client.

**Additional Requirements**

Physical: Standing or sitting for long periods; must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times and spend extended hours in front of a computer screen.

Cognitive: Problem-solving, written, and verbal communication skills; computer and software skills; and ability to read and interpret text online or in printed form.

We are committed to a culture of equity, diversity, and inclusion. We affirm and respect diverse backgrounds and opinions because we believe they yield the best solutions for our clients. We promote emotional intelligence and trust by nurturing these values within our new hires.

We encourage staff to develop rewarding, long-term careers at PMA, and we implement formal leadership development programs that help you attain your goals. At PMA, shared success is a core value. Every employee who contributes is recognized, celebrated, and rewarded. We look for self-driven candidates eager to assume responsibility and join a community of respect founded on collaboration and accountability, not titles. If you aim to transform the project management practice toward continuous improvement of project outcomes, the profession, and yourself, PMA looks forward to warmly welcoming you to our team.

We offer competitive pay and benefits, wellness programs for you and your family, and career development opportunities to advance your professional goals.

As a PMA professional, you will be empowered to make timely and effective decisions and significant daily contributions to complex facets of project delivery. Join a team that has achieved a world-class reputation in the construction industry and has been voted a “Best Place to Work.”

jobs.title: FP&A Analyst
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

We are Waste Harmonics Keter, your partner in handling complex waste operations.

Growing steadily for nearly 25 years, we have become the choice provider for managed waste services by pairing high-touch, white-glove customer service with data-driven, tech-enabled programs. From developing proprietary monitoring technology to linking arms with other industry leaders to strengthen our operations, we have a storied history of doing what's needed to serve our customers well.

**Who We’re Looking For**

The **FP&A Analyst** plays a key role in supporting financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance reporting across the organization. Working closely with the Senior FP&A Analyst and reporting to the Head of Finance Partnering & FP&A, this position provides financial insights that support strategic decision-making and drive business performance.

The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and proactive, with a strong understanding of financial principles and a passion for translating complex data into actionable business insights. This individual thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys collaborating with cross-functional teams, and brings a continuous-improvement mindset to financial processes and reporting.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Support company-wide budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning processes, ensuring accuracy and alignment with business objectives
* Prepare monthly financial statements, including income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements, for review by the Senior FP&A Analyst
* Develop financial and operational reports to support executive leadership and business decision-making
* Analyze financial performance against budgets and forecasts, identifying variances, trends, and key business drivers
* Partner with functional leaders across Commercial, Operations, ST&P, and CPTO to provide financial insights and support informed decisions
* Assist with forecast updates, accruals, cash flow reporting, and ongoing financial performance monitoring
* Conduct ad hoc financial and operational analyses to support business initiatives, leadership requests, and shareholder reporting
* Support financial business cases by evaluating program costs, performance, and potential financial impact
* Collaborate with the Program Management Office (PMO) to support program budgeting, financial tracking, and reporting
* Partner with the Data & Insights team to improve reporting consistency, leverage analytical tools, and support self-service reporting capabilities
* Maintain financial processes, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and documentation while identifying opportunities to strengthen controls
* Identify reporting inefficiencies and recommend process improvements that enhance accuracy, efficiency, and financial visibility
* Support executive, Board, and investor reporting requirements while meeting established deadlines

**What You’ll Bring to the Table**

* 2–4 years of experience in Financial Planning & Analysis, Accounting, Financial Analysis, or a related finance role
* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Economics, Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* Strong understanding of financial statements, accounting principles, budgeting, and forecasting
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, complex formulas, and data visualization
* Experience analyzing large datasets, identifying trends, and explaining financial performance drivers
* Experience supporting annual budgeting, financial forecasting, and financial statement preparation
* Strong financial modeling, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities
* Ability to interpret complex financial information and communicate insights to business stakeholders
* Strong attention to detail with a commitment to accuracy and data integrity
* Excellent organizational and time management skills with the ability to meet competing deadlines
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across departments
* Proactive, adaptable, and comfortable working independently while contributing to team objectives

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with FP&A software such as **Datarails**
* Familiarity with **Oracle NetSuite, Power BI**, or similar ERP and reporting platforms
* Experience creating Excel macros or automating financial reporting processes
* Experience supporting investor, Board, or executive-level financial reporting
* Experience contributing to financial process improvements, reporting enhancements, or system optimization initiatives
* Experience working in a cross-functional finance environment and supporting financial business cases

**What’s Good to Know**

* This role is part of the **Finance team** and reports to the Head of Finance Partnering & FP&A
* The position works closely with the Senior FP&A Analyst and supports financial business partnering across multiple departments
* The role combines financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and process improvement
* Collaboration with functional leadership and the Data & Insights team is an important part of the position
* Success requires strong financial acumen, analytical thinking, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate the story behind the numbers
* The position offers opportunities to expand financial expertise, contribute to cross-functional initiatives, and take on greater ownership of financial deliverables

**What We Bring to the Table**

* Competitive Compensation
* Annual Bonus Plan at Every Level
* Continuous Learning and Development Opportunities
* 401(k) Retirement Savings with Company Match; Immediate Vesting
* Medical & Dental Insurance

We are a technology-driven company. We built our business with the purpose of empowering people and improving their organizations, one payment at a time.

We started our journey by providing smart and simple payment processing tools and products but haven’t stopped there. We are backed by a team of world-class experts and the best technology talent, and we are committed to helping more new businesses get started, increase the revenues of our customers, and bridge the gap between online merchants and payment solutions.

Our mission is to give companies the tools they need to change the future of their business.

**Job Summary**

Risk Analyst is responsible to review and analyze financials and credit of merchant accounts, merchant financial and activity risk, compliance with law and association rules and other operational duties in the normal course of merchant acquiring business.

Daily tasks will include ongoing monitoring of Payarc’s merchant portfolio for fraud and credit risk exposure across all supported platforms and related tools by utilizing sound judgment and strong risk mitigation strategies.

Requirements:

**Responsibilities and Duties**

* Responsible for the daily, weekly and monthly exception monitoring of Merchant Acquiring Accounts
* Individual is responsible for financial analysis of prospective merchant accounts in accordance with the Merchant Services Policy and Card Brand regulations

* Periodically review existing merchants to ensure compliance with Financial Guidelines and risk standards
* Works closely with risk staff, underwriters, and client liaisons to manage risk perceptions on accounts, communicate information obtained about activity and facilitate resolutions
* Communicate merchant account changes decisions effectively in both verbal and written communication
* Responsible for establishing and maintaining relationships with assigned clients
* Providing ongoing education and guidance to clients regarding risk mitigation strategies
* Provide operational assistance as needed with changes in customer’s limits, merchant accounts changes and terminations
* Collaborate with various departments throughout the organization to improve the quality of tasks and procedures
* Adhere to Payarc’s compliance procedures and internal/operational risk controls in accordance with any applicable bank or card brand regulatory standard, requirements, and policies.
* Ensures Payarc’s internal controls are documented appropriately and effectively.
* Identify and trace any suspicious activities or high-risk transactions
* Analyze credit and financial statements
* Credit authority of $75,000
* Other duties as assigned

* Detail oriented and must have the ability to prioritize all tasks appropriately
* Sense of ownership and pride in your performance and its impact on company’s success
* Team player
* Strong technical aptitude and willingness to learn
* Strong interpersonal skills for interacting effectively with key internal and external contacts
* Excellent analytical skills, strong attention to detail
* Judgement and resourcefulness to solve problems independently
* Able to make real-time decisions

**Qualifications/Experience Required**

* 6+ months of relevant experience
* Risk mitigation experience preferred
* Experience underwriting merchant services accounts preferred

* Bachelor's degree preferred

**Job Title: Treasury Analyst**

**Team: Operations**

**Job Location: Remote (must be located in Long Island, New York)**

  
About UsJoin us in revolutionizing healthcare! We build software that simplifies the process of choosing the right health insurance for individuals. Our solutions help our health plan and government customers with the administration, reporting, and operational requirements of their plans. By tackling the complexities of enrollment, administration, renewal, billing, and more, we enable our customers and partners to concentrate on advancing their core missions.Our Company Culture

Our culture is built on collaboration, innovation, and appreciation. We value each employee's unique talents and contributions and understand that every individual plays a critical role in our mission to transform healthcare. Every day, we celebrate our team's dedication, creativity, and expertise, which drive us closer to our goals.

At Softheon, our mission is making healthcare more affordable, accessible, and plentiful for every American. Our vision is that everyone can access and choose the healthcare they need.

  
About the Role

Softheon is seeking a Treasury Analyst to support the day-to-day management of banking and treasury activities. This role is responsible for supporting client daily cash-position oversight, revenue projections, intercompany billing, cash-flow monitoring, reconciliations, and financial reporting.

The Treasury Analyst will partner with clients, banking partners, merchant processors, vendors, and internal stakeholders to maintain accurate financial operations, support compliance, identify variances, and improve treasury processes and controls. The ideal candidate combines sound financial judgment, strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

 **Requirements**  
  
You Will:

**Cash Management & Reconciliation**

* Assist in the handling of cash management operations.
* Prepare daily, monthly, and annual cash reconciliations.
* Prepare cash flow reports and monitor cash flows on a weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual basis to identify and evaluate variances.

**Account Administration & Client Liaison**

* Assist in account administration, including setting up clients within the banking partner’s systems and managing user setups and maintenance.
* Act as a liaison between clients and the banking partner for billing and cash flow matters.
* Act as a liaison between clients and the Merchant Processor, including setting up and maintaining merchant accounts.

**Compliance & Audit**

* Ensure compliance with treasury management policies and procedures.
* Audit fees from Softheon’s merchant service provider and bank to ensure proper billing.
* Validate and reconcile monthly invoices from all vendors.

**Reporting & Process Improvement**

* Assist in the preparation of reports and proposals for cash management improvement.
* Prepare cash flow reports for management to use in identifying and evaluating variances.
* Stay current on banking/treasury trends and implement efficiencies and improvements as needed, such as Same-Day ACH payments.

**Financial Records & Documentation**

* Ensure proper retention and organization of the firm’s financial transactions and records.
* Document and implement improvements within the Treasury department.

**Talent Management**

* Collaborate with the Talent team to actively engage in the hiring and recruitment process, including but not limited to participating in interviews.
* Leverage industry networks and expertise to identify and attract top talent that aligns with the company's objectives and values.
* Provide guidance and mentorship to team members within your department and across diverse functions.
* Play an integral role in shaping and reinforcing the overall company culture, promoting values that enhance teamwork, collaboration, and employee engagement.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Must be available for on-call duty once a month during IT maintenances and then during peak periods, providing support outside of regular working hours as needed to ensure the timely resolution of critical issues.
* Although we work in a remote-first environment, all roles require in-person attendance at our headquarters approximately 2 times per year (in addition to other travel requirements for this specific role, if applicable). These visits are essential for team collaboration, strategic planning, and fostering deeper connections across the organization. Travel arrangements will be supported to ensure a seamless experience.
* Travel to the headquarters in Stony Brook, New York is required once a month.
* Must be located within commutable range and reside in Nassau or Suffolk County of Long Island, New York.
* This role requires participation in a rotating weekend-support schedule, typically one weekend per month, based on regular business and operational needs.

  
You Have

**Education**

* Bachelor's Degree or higher in Business Administration, Economics, Computer Science, or Informational Technology.

**Experience**

* 1-3 years of relevant professional experience in treasury, corporate finance, accounting, cash management, merchant services, or a related field.
* 2 or more years of work experience in merchant services within an IT healthcare company is preferred.
* Familiarity with Software as a Service (SaaS) environments and Azure DevOps is desired.
* Experience analyzing, building, and maintaining financial models and reporting financial performance is preferred.

**Certifications: ( or must be obtained within 90 days)**

jobs.title: Analyst, Financial Asset Management
jobs.description:
The Analyst of Financial Asset Management is responsible for supporting day‑to‑day financial execution for the regional portfolio. This role focuses on portfolio maintenance, preparation of Investment Committee materials, and analytical support for asset management and transaction initiatives. **Primary Responsibilities**

**Portfolio Maintenance & Financial Data Management**

* Maintain asset‑level financial models used for forecasting, planning, and reporting
* Update models for leasing activity, capital expenditures, budget changes, and other asset‑level events
* Coordinate with property management and leasing teams to gather required inputs
* Perform routine data checks and reconciliations to identify errors, inconsistencies, or missing inputs

**IC Preparation & Support**

* Support preparation and updating of IC materials for the regional portfolio
* Populate models, tables, exhibits, and supporting analyses used in IC submissions
* Ensure IC materials are consistent with underlying models
* Incorporate feedback from the Manager accurately and efficiently

**Asset Management Project Support**

* Provide analytical support for approved asset management initiatives and projects
* Prepare ad‑hoc analyses and exhibits to support leasing, capital planning, and operational decisions

**Transaction Support**

* Support Transaction underwriting and diligence processes
* Develop asset-level Argus models for potential acquisition and disposition opportunities
* Refine acquisition underwriting models for transition into the Argus Financial Asset Management environment

**Reporting & Ongoing Analysis**

* Prepare recurring financial reports and summaries for regional and executive use
* Coordinate with Property Management to produce analyses that estimate recovery impact on incremental spend
* Be responsive to regional requests for ad hoc financial analysis

**Team & Process Support**

* Support Manager‑led workflows and recurring processes
* Build and leverage AI and PowerBI tools to improve team efficiency and decision-making
* Identify data gaps or process inefficiencies and raise them to the Manager

**Success Looks Like**

* Financial models and materials that are consistently accurate and well‑maintained
* IC analyses that require minimal rework at the Manager level
* Timely completion of recurring and ad‑hoc requests
* Strong attention to detail and responsiveness to feedback
* Dependable execution that enables Managers and Directors to operate efficiently

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree required – finance, real estate, business, or economics major preferred
* Entry-level to one year of analyst experience
* Exposure to ARGUS preferred but not required
* Advanced proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, Word
* Ability to multi-task and work well in a team-focused environment
* Excellent communication and organizational skills
* Professional approach and demeanor

The base salary range for this position has been established as $75,000-$85,000 PLUS participation in our annual cash bonus plan. This salary range represents the Company’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation at the time of posting.

Brixmor offers a hybrid work schedule (first three days of the week in the office, the balance remote optional), very competitive pay commensurate with background and responsibilities plus a benefits and perks package that supports career engagement, growth, good health and connection with teammates and our communities.

jobs.title: Lead Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA)
jobs.description:
**About Children’s Specialized ABA**

Children’s Specialized ABA is part of the Children’s Specialized Hospital Autism Center of Excellence. We serve children with ASD by combining clinical innovation, whole-child care, and personalized therapy.? At Children’s Specialized ABA, we envision a future where every child diagnosed with autism has access to innovative and compassionate care, empowering them to thrive and reach their full potential. Our vision is built on four core values:

* **Inclusivity**: We celebrate the diversity within the Autism spectrum and are committed to creating an inclusive environment that respects and values each person’s individual strengths and differences.
* **Innovation**: We foster a culture of creativity and collaboration, exploring new ideas to develop personalized solutions that enhance quality of life for all children with Autism.
* **Connection**: We actively engage with the health systems and broader community to coordinate services and care for people with Autism.
* **Quality and Safety**: We invest in research and training to provide cutting-edge, effective, safe, and personalized services tailored to the unique needs of those we serve.

**Join Us as a Lead BCBA in our Social Connections Program!**

The Lead BCBA serves as the primary clinical leader for the after-school Social Connections Program while maintaining a center-based daytime caseload. This role combines clinical responsibilities with program oversight, staff development, quality assurance, and implementation support. The Lead BCBA supports participant placement, coaches staff, monitors treatment fidelity, and ensures individualized treatment goals are integrated into meaningful social learning opportunities. During program startup and growth, the Lead BCBA may also provide direct case oversight as additional BCBAs are hired and trained. This position collaborates with clinical, program development, and operational leadership to support program quality, growth, and long-term sustainability.

**About the Social Connections Program**

The Social Connections Program is a center-based, after-school ABA program for school-aged learners that combines individualized treatment with structured peer interactions. Through engaging social activities, learners build communication, social, emotional regulation, adaptive, and problem-solving skills in a supportive and collaborative environment. As a Lead BCBA, you will work a schedule of **10:45 a.m. to 7:15 p.m.**, providing clinical leadership and support during the program’s after-school service hours.

**What You'll Do**

**Direct Clinical Responsibilities**

* Maintain direct BCBA service delivery and billable activity in alignment with organizational expectations
* Conduct comprehensive behavioral assessments and reassessments, including Functional Behavior Assessments (FBAs) and skills assessments, to identify target behaviors
* Train and supervise Behavior Technicians (BTs), Registered Behavior Technicians (RBTs), and other team members on intervention strategies.
* Review and analyze clinical data regularly to guide treatment decisions and improve client outcomes
* Provide ongoing training and support to families, caregivers, and relevant stakeholders in behavioral strategies
* Provide treatment that is in accordance with BACB’s guidelines, policies, procedures, and ethical standards set forth by the Company

**Clinical Leadership**

* Serve as the primary clinical leader for the Social Connections Program ensuring fidelity of ABA programming across the center
* Ensure clinical practices are evidence-based, ethically implemented, and aligned with organizational and regulatory standards
* Provide program leadership through effective management of clinical operations, staffing, organizational priorities, and interdisciplinary collaboration
* Support participant placement and group composition to foster meaningful and mutually beneficial social skills groups
* Guide the development and implementation of clinical policies and procedures to ensure alignment between best clinical practices and operational decisions
* Serve as the clinical lead for escalated families, addressing compliance issues and complex clinical concerns
* Develop and deliver CEU training for BCBAs to maintain certification and build clinical skills

**Supervision and Staff Development**

* Support onboarding, orientation, and ongoing training for clinical staff
* Provide leadership oversight, coaching, and performance feedback for assigned direct reports
* Conduct semiannual performance evaluations, identify individual development goals, and monitor quarterly and annual KPIs to ensure productivity and high performance of assigned direct reports
* Lead clinical meetings and promote a culture of collaboration, professional development, and clinical excellence

The energy of a newsroom, the pace of a trading floor, the buzz of a recent tech breakthrough; we work hard, and we work fast - while keeping up the quality and accuracy we're known for. You embark on a career journey with the leaders of luxury wines, champagnes, and spirits, within the prestigious LVMH Group. From nature to communities, you’ll craft unforgettable experiences that drive the collective success of our 26 Maisons – each one with a unique heritage and set within the most remarkable terroirs the world has to offer. **You enter a world of possibility** where career development opportunities across our Maisons, our 5 global regions, and the entire LVMH Group, are unmatched. You **join a passionate community of talents** that spans four generations and combines a wealth of roles and skillsets from the roots of the vine to the glass and everything in between **. You discover our essential** **relationship** with our terroirs, and how we nurture and preserve the soils which are the source of our singular products. Our global Living Soils Living Together program has four key commitments for 2030: regenerating soils, mitigating our climate impact, engaging society, and empowering our people **. You will share in our passion** for hosting, for art-de-vivre as well as our pride in creating products that celebrate life’s most memorable milestones, while always experienced through measured, responsible tasting.

**Moët Hennessy** is proud to promote a diverse, equitable and inclusive working environment for all. As an employer, Moët Hennessy offers unique journeys throughout its global ecosystem, opportunities to develop new skills and grow professionally. If you want to inspire and be inspired, to craft experiences and experience the best in craftsmanship, this is where you’ll flourish.

The Trade CRM Specialist is a change enablement role that combines strategic, analytical, and operational responsibilities, with a strong focus on user support, training, and adoption of MHUSA’s Trade CRM ecosystem, known internally as ASPIRE, which combines Salesforce for customer relationship management and sales execution with Power BI for reporting, analytics, and data visualization. The role helps Commercial teams effectively leverage these platforms to streamline day-to-day activities, improve customer engagement, and drive more informed, data-driven decision-making.

Working cross-functionally with internal stakeholders, the Trade CRM Specialist serves as a key resource for end users, providing ongoing training, troubleshooting, and guidance to maximize platform adoption and business value. The role also supports the development of actionable dashboards, reporting capabilities, and analytics aligned with MHUSA’s commercial priorities, while promoting best practices and continuous improvement across the organization.

***Office/Location: Hybrid 3x a week based out of*** ***NYC Office***

Compensation: $67,000-$80,000/ Annually + Bonus

### **Job responsibilities**

**Role and Responsibilities**

**1.** **User Training, Support & Adoption**

Serve as a primary resource for day-to-day user support across ASPIRE, Power BI, and related reporting tools. Lead new-user onboarding, deliver ongoing training, troubleshoot functional issues, and develop practical learning materials, including presentations, videos, and quick-reference guides. Support platform rollouts and adoption initiatives, helping users confidently navigate systems, access reports, and incorporate these tools into their daily workflows.

**2.** **Platform Optimization & Continuous Improvement**

Gather and document business requirements and relevant information to effectively triage, troubleshoot, and resolve system issues in collaboration with technical teams. Coordinate testing, validation, and implementation of bug fixes and enhancements, while maintaining clear and timely communication with impacted users and departments throughout the resolution process. Ensure issues are tracked through completion. Identify opportunities to improve platform functionality, streamline workflows, and enhance the user experience.

  

**3.** **Performance Analytics & Reporting**

Develop, maintain, and enhance Power BI dashboards, Salesforce reports, and analytical tools that provide actionable insights into Commercial performance. Monitor key performance indicators, evaluate sales execution and activation effectiveness, and conduct trend and root cause analyses to identify performance gaps and opportunities for improvement. Ensure reporting aligns with business priorities and supports informed decision-making across the organization.

**4.** **Data Stewardship & Quality Assurance**

Support data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across Salesforce and Power BI. Investigate data discrepancies, identify underlying issues, and coordinate with Data and IT teams on resolution. Promote data quality standards and best practices to ensure reliable reporting and maintain confidence in the underlying information.

**5.** **Data Analytics Best Practices**

Promote a data-driven culture by sharing analytical best practices, collaborating with other analysts/specialists, and helping stakeholders build their understanding of available tools and insights. Contribute to MHUSA's broader analytics community and support the adoption of consistent reporting methodologies and performance measurement standards across teams.

### **Profile**

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

Additional certifications or training in Salesforce, Microsoft Power BI, or data analytics are a plus.

**Professional Experience:**

2+ years of professional experience in sales, marketing, business analytics, or a related field. Experience in the wine and spirits industry is a plus.

* Hands-on experience working with Salesforce CRM, including user support, reporting, and platform functionality.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft

### **Description**

The Assistant Property/Operations Manager will be expected to take an active role in supporting the execution of a multitude of asset-level operational and development initiatives for one of New York City’s premier real estate investment firms under general direction from the firm’s Director of Operations. The Assistant Manager will have the rare opportunity to learn the real estate business through a multi-faceted lens and gain invaluable experience with a holistic view of the firm’s investment strategies. Additionally, the Analyst will benefit from regular engagement with Principals and senior management team members.

This dynamic role will initially be focused on daily operations of a commercial building in Astoria, Queens while lending field and office assistance for apartment turns, a light construction team, property management and project management across Stellar’s portfolio. Primary responsibilities will include managing and overseeing third party contractors, a light construction team, building staff, property operations, and ongoing development projects with the ultimate goal of achieving the financial and operational objectives of the portfolio.

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Assist in managing and overseeing all building staff, property operations, and ongoing development projects to achieve the financial and operational objectives of the business plan
* Ability to assist in the management and deployment of a light construction crew and other field personnel including Superintendents.
* Collaborate with the Director of Business Operations and Asset Managers to understand property-specific goals and assist in implementing plans to achieve those objectives.
* Supervise and schedule apartment turnovers, coordinating with cleaning, painting, and maintenance teams to ensure standards and deadlines are met.
* Execute on Key Performance Indicators as defined in the business plan
* Assist with the hiring, training/onboarding, scheduling, and management of on-site building staff
* Work with management to prepare and maintain operating and capital budgets and support the implementation and execution of construction projects on site
* Assist procuring and monitoring third-party vendors and the reporting on status of ongoing projects
* Compile and ensure completion of construction punch lists including project close-out documentation
* Process and track vendor invoicing via AIA documents, lien waivers, & contractor affidavits
* Assist in reviewing contracts, vendors, staffing, and maintenance practices to identify expense reductions
* Oversee the lease renewal process and help negotiate renewal terms to retain occupancy for three rental buildings in the portfolio

* Oversee resident services and communications to achieve high customer satisfaction and retention
* Work with the maintenance team to ensure that apartments, common areas and grounds are maintained
* Assist with the leasing process when necessary, including pricing, marketing, showings, and issuing new leases
* Oversee turnover process of recently vacated apartments to ensure quality results and timely completion
* Attend to emergencies on-site outside of normal business hours if/when needed
* Additional operational tasks include: monitoring and handling resident payments and collections with the accounting department, preparing accident and insurance claims, and scheduling tenant move-ins / outs.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent preferred
* 1-3 years of relevant of experience in property management
* Bilingual (Spanish) a plus
* 5 days on-site required (corporate and field)
* **Ability to travel to, and around, the Bronx and Yonkers locations**
* Ability to safely navigate a construction site
* Must be able to sit and stand for extended periods of time.
* Must be able to communicate both on the phone and in person with our clients to resolve issues and manage the business.
* A commitment to performing high-quality work in a collaborative environment on a growing team.
* Ability to prioritize, identify and implement operational initiatives.
* Ability to demonstrate self-motivation and an intellectual curiosity with a dedication to continually find ways to positively impact operational processes and key personnel to improve property-level performance.
* Strong interpersonal skills with an ability to effectively communicate with individuals across all levels of the firm including building staff, leasing teams, and senior management.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate and manage a team
* Strong organization skills with a penchant for paying attention to detail.
* Strong customer service and verbal/written communication skills
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint and Word. Experience with Yardi software and CMS helpful, but not required.
* Knowledge of building systems and building maintenance preferred.
* Familiarity with local real estate laws and regulations helpful, but not required.

  

### **About Stellar Management**

jobs.description:
The NFL's Marketing Strategy, Planning & Insights team serves as a center of excellence for the League, shaping how the NFL grows fans, strengthens the brand, and drives engagement across the U.S. and international markets. The team brings together consumer insights, audience strategy, business planning, initiative-level strategy, and performance measurement to ground decisions in fan understanding, market dynamics, and business priorities. Partnering across business functions and key stakeholders (e.g., the 32 NFL Clubs, partners), the team delivers actionable insights, strategic guidance, and planning frameworks that inform both long-term strategy and day-to-day decisions.

Within this team, Consumer Insights designs and conducts primary research, integrates syndicated and first-party data, and delivers actionable insights across global fan development, brand health, media, live events, marketing effectiveness, partnerships, social responsibility, and player-related priorities.

The Manager, Global Strategic Insights supports research development, analysis, and insights generation to inform global fan development and business growth. The role conducts and synthesizes primary research, syndicated sources, first-party data, and market intelligence to ensure Leaguewide decision-making is grounded in a fan-first perspective.

**Responsibilities**

**Global Fandom Intelligence**

* Monitor fandom, avidity, engagement, and brand health, as well as the drivers of and barriers to each.
* Analyze cultural, behavioral, and regional differences to identify opportunities to acquire, develop, engage, and monetize fans.
* Leverage NFL-specific and macro landscape insights to support the development of audience-level strategies by demographic, market, and other relevant segmentation lenses, such as engagement level and football knowledge.

**Strategic Insights & Business Planning**

* Support strategic analyses, forecasts, scenario planning, and performance measurement tied to near- and long-range priorities.
* Connect fan behavior, research findings, and marketplace trends to business opportunities and actionable recommendations.
* Develop executive-ready presentations, memos, and key planning documents.

**Consumer Insights & Research Execution**

* Support qualitative and quantitative research from objective setting and methodology selection through questionnaire or discussion guide development, analysis, and reporting.
* Manage day-to-day stakeholder and vendor coordination, timelines, and deliverables across multiple projects.
* Synthesize primary research, syndicated data, first-party information, and secondary sources into concise, story-driven visuals and recommendations using best-in-class practices.

**Brand, Media & Marketing Effectiveness**

* Measure brand campaigns, creative effectiveness, audience sentiment, cultural relevance, and other equity measures across markets and fan segments.
* Analyze broadcast, streaming, direct-to-consumer, content, and emerging viewing experiences to inform audience growth, media, product, and marketing strategies.
* Evaluate new products, events, experiences, and fan engagement initiatives across the NFL ecosystem.

**Stakeholder Partnership & Team Contribution**

* Build collaborative relationships across the League, Clubs, markets, and external research partners, advocating for fan-centric, insight-driven decisions.
* Communicate complex research through clear, concise storytelling tailored to varied audiences.
* Coordinate multiple workstreams while maintaining quality, timing, and business relevance.
* Support junior team members through coaching and project guidance, and improve research processes, reporting standards, and insight socialization.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of relevant experience in consumer insights, market research, strategy, analytics, or a related field.
* Ability to translate business questions into research objectives and quantitative or qualitative research plans.
* Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex findings and communicate concise, actionable insights to varied stakeholders.
* Strong data visualization and storytelling skills, with experience creating executive-ready presentations and insight-driven reports.
* Strong project management, cross-functional collaboration, and relationship-building skills in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience with research methods such as segmentation, surveys, ethnography, interviews, and focus groups, plus familiarity with syndicated media measurement and applied analytics.
* Proficiency with analytical tools such as Microsoft Excel, SPSS, or Q.
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent professional experience.

**Other Key Attributes / Characteristics**

* Experience managing vendors and/or analysts; strong people management capabilities preferred.
* Familiarity with sports and entertainment; knowledge of media and live events is a plus.
* Experience working with global or multinational businesses and measurement frameworks strongly preferred.
* Spanish, Portuguese, French, and/or German language proficiency is a plus.
* Master’s degree in Market Research preferred.

**Terms / Expected Hours of Work**

* Some travel required
* NFL employees are required to work in office

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Morgan Health is a mission-driven healthcare organization within JPMorgan Chase focused on improving the quality, affordability, and experience of employer-sponsored healthcare. We operate with the focus and agility of a smaller, specialized team, backed by the scale, resources, and reach of one of the world's largest companies. Our team brings together healthcare, data, research, investment, and policy expertise to tackle some of the most complex challenges facing employers and their employees. If you are someone who wants their technical work to have a tangible impact on healthcare, this is a unique opportunity to build within a highly collaborative team to further Morgan Health's mission.

As a Senior Analytics Engineer within Morgan Health, you'll play a key role in building the data foundation behind that work. You'll have meaningful ownership of Morgan Health's analytics environment, partnering closely with data scientists as well as other internal and external stakeholders to turn complex healthcare data into trusted, production-ready data marts that support research, insights, and decision-making. In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape how analytics engineering is done within Morgan Health — not simply inherit an established process. You will own and evolve core elements of the analytics life cycle, from data modeling and testing to CI/CD, monitoring and quality standards. Because we're a focused team, you will work closely with the people using the data and have visibility into how your work contributes to healthcare research, insights, and ultimately better outcomes.

**This role is in-office five days per week, based in either New York, NY or Washington, DC.**

jobs.description:
**About the Role:**
===================

**Grade Level (for internal use):**

11

Job Description

**The Role**

As a Cyber Incident Response Analyst, you will be part of the Cyber Defence team that develops and oversees the company's security program, ensuring S&P Global is protected from existing and emerging threats. In close partnership with Security Operations and Threat Intelligence, you will detect, analyze, and decisively respond to security incidents, enrich investigations with timely intelligence, and help drive proactive defences. While based in the UK, you will support response and intelligence needs globally.

Candidates should have a genuine interest in cyber security and a strong grasp of attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs). This role requires a detail-oriented, critical thinker who understands how adversaries exploit systems, networks, and people—and how to respond. Experience applying threat intelligence to investigations and to improve detections is highly desirable.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and triage response to cybersecurity events and conduct forensic analysis across endpoints, networks, cloud, and SaaS.
* Integrate threat intelligence into investigations (e.g., enrich IOCs, map activity to MITRE ATT&CK, identify likely threat actors/TTPs, and assess potential impact).
* Understand the threat landscape through collaboration with industry peers, FS-ISAC, trust groups, and commercial/open-source intelligence, translating insights into actionable recommendations.
* Develop, maintain, and operationalize Incident Response playbooks and SOPs; include PIRs (Priority Intelligence Requirements), collection plans, and feedback loops to refine detections.
* Work closely with the SOC to investigate incidents and deliver containment, remediation, and root cause analysis; produce high-quality intel-informed incident reports.
* Create and tune detections (e.g., SIEM/SOAR, EDR) using intelligence signals (TTPs, behaviors, YARA/Sigma where applicable).
* Produce and present consumable intelligence outputs (e.g., flash alerts, threat overviews, executive briefs) tailored to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Contribute to vulnerability/threat surfacing (e.g., emerging CVEs, exploit trends) and advise on risk-based prioritization.
* Deliver actionable incident and hunting metrics to management; assess detection coverage and recommend improvements.
* Follow the end-to-end incident response lifecycle and support post-incident lessons learned with intelligence-driven enhancements.
* Build an understanding of key S&P technology, systems, and business practices to contextualize threats and drive pragmatic defenses.
* Participate in information-sharing activities (e.g., FS-ISAC submissions) in line with TLP and legal/compliance requirements.

**Required Qualifications**

* Working knowledge of common cyber attacks, tools, and attacker tradecraft; ability to map activity to MITRE ATT&CK and articulate likely TTPs.
* Demonstrated experience handling security events in critical environments and applying intelligence to accelerate triage and response.
* Experience analyzing system, application, and cloud/SaaS logs to investigate security and operational issues; comfort enriching with IOCs and behaviours.
* Hands-on experience with a SIEM (Splunk preferred) for investigations, alert creation, reporting, and threat hunting.
* Ability to produce clear, actionable intel and incident reports, including executive-ready summaries and visuals.
* Familiarity with threat intel workflows: collection planning, source evaluation, indicator lifecycle, PIRs, TLP, and feedback loops to detections.
* Experience with one or more TIPs or intel data sources (e.g., MISP, OpenCTI, Recorded Future) and STIX/TAXII concepts.
* 3+ years of information security experience with a focus on incident response, threat hunting, or threat intelligence.
* Excellent communication skills for varied business and technical audiences; strong presentation skills.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment; passion for cyber security.
* Advanced knowledge of network protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP) and operating systems.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in the financial services industry.
* Familiarity with threat hunting techniques (hypothesis-driven, ATT&CK-aligned, behavior-based).
* Windows and Linux administration tools and concepts.
* Understanding of threat actors and the cybercrime ecosystem, including initial access vectors, monetization paths, and supply-chain/SaaS attack patterns.
* Exposure to malware/TTP analysis at a functional level (family identification, persistence/discovery behaviors) and creation of detections (e.g., Sigma/YARA) is a plus.
* Experience producing finished intelligence products (tactical through executive) and briefing senior stakeholders.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., GCTI, GCFA/GCFR, GCIH, FOR578) or equivalent experience.
* Familiarity with information-sharing standards and practices (FS-ISAC, TLP) and legal/compliance considerations.
* Knowledge of cloud provider threat models and telemetry (AWS, Azure, GCP, M365/SaaS).
* Second language and/or geopolitical awareness for actor context is a plus.

**Compensation/Benefits Information:**

(This section is only applicable to US candidates) S&P Global states that the anticipated base salary range for this position is $100,000 to $170,000. Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual’s geographic location, as well as experience level, skill set, training, licenses and certifications.

In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan. This role is not eligible for additional compensation such as an annual incentive bonus or sales commission plan. The role partners with risk managers and business stakeholders to identify and transform manual workflows into scalable, data-driven solutions - leveraging tools such as Python, SQL, machine learning frameworks, RPA platforms, and data visualization technologies to support anomaly detection, predictive analytics, and regulatory reporting.

* Design, develop, and implement automated solutions to streamline risk management workflows, monitoring, and reporting.
* Build and maintain AI/ML models to support risk division in repetitive activities (e.g., anomaly detection, predictive analytics).
* Develop dashboards and automated reporting tools to improve visibility into risks and emerging trends.
* Collaborate with risk managers and business stakeholders to identify manual processes suitable for automation and prioritize solution development.
* Integrate data from multiple sources to create unified, reliable datasets for risk analysis and regulatory reporting.
* Evaluate and recommend emerging AI tools, platforms, and technologies that can enhance the team's capabilities.
* Document solution designs, code, and processes to ensure transparency, reproducibility, and auditability.
* Support governance and validation efforts for AI/ML models in alignment with AI frameworks.
* Uses independent judgement and discretion to make model development decisions.
* Analyzes and resolves problems pertaining to model performance issues.

**ADDITIONAL ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* Performs special projects, and additional duties and responsibilities as required.

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**

**Required Qualifications:**

* Education level required: Undergraduate Degree (4 years or equivalent) Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical field.
* Minimum experience required: 2+ Years (including internships, academic projects, or freelance work) in one or more of the following: Python, R, SQL, or similar programming languages, Machine learning / AI frameworks, Robotic Process Automation (RPA) tools (e.g., Power Automate, Automation Anywhere), Data visualization tools (e.g., PowerBI, PowerAutomate).

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Exposure to banking, financial services, or risk management concepts.
* Familiarity with regulatory frameworks (e.g., OCC guidelines, FDIC regulations, Basel standards).
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and API integrations.
* Knowledge of generative AI applications (e.g., LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG architectures).
* Understanding of model risk management principles and AI governance best practices.
* Relevant certifications such as AWS Cloud Practitioner, Azure AI Fundamentals, or FRM/PRM.

**Job Competencies:**

* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with high attention to detail and accuracy.
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Ability to clearly articulate, in writing or orally, ideas, analytic insights, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences, including an executive audience.

Aligns relationship building efforts with enterprise goals to accelerate performance and drive strategic results.

**The Team**

Credit Ratings is an integral part of S&P Global's Global Ratings Services, bringing together a diverse group of more than 1,400 analysts across key financial centers worldwide. The Corporates Ratings practice delivers forward-looking credit insights on a wide range of corporate entities, producing independent rating opinions that markets and investors rely on to understand how evolving risks affect financial stability and credit performance. The team provides analytical coverage of corporate issuers across the Transportation, Automotive, Aerospace & Defense, and Engineering & Construction sectors, monitoring industry trends, evaluating company performance and credit risk, and contributing to the ongoing assessment and maintenance of credit ratings.

  
  

**Responsibilities and Impact**

Impact

This role plays a key part in delivering the independent, rigorous credit analysis that underpins S&P Global Ratings' trusted, decision-ready intelligence. The Senior Analyst leads analysis for an assigned corporate portfolio, synthesizing complex financial and market data into clear, committee-ready rating opinions. By integrating AI-enabled tools with deep analytical expertise, the role drives productivity, quality, and consistency across the credit process — contributing to analysis that informs investors, issuers, and market participants globally.

  
  

Responsibilities

Team Contribution & Capability Building

* Provide day-to-day coaching and guidance to Research Assistants and Rating Analysts, building capability in credit analysis, data discipline, and analytical tooling while reinforcing values-driven behaviors.
* Drive consistency and scalability by codifying standard work and promoting the disciplined adoption of shared analytical practices across the team.
* Strengthen AI-enabled productivity by developing reusable assets and proposing lightweight automations that free capacity for higher-value human analysis and relationship work.
* Partner with senior team members and Data and Engineering colleagues to identify, design, and scale AI and automation use cases with governance built in from the outset.
  

  

Core Analytical & Delivery

* Lead end-to-end execution for assigned credits, ensuring high-quality analysis and timely delivery with clear accountability across priorities.
* Own ongoing surveillance for an assigned portfolio, synthesizing performance data, market signals, and peer context into decision-useful insights with clear risk implications.
* Support the embedding of AI and automation tools into analytical workflows, applying structured validation and analytical judgment to maintain the integrity and reliability of conclusions.
* Prepare and review key analytical outputs — including model inputs, metrics, assumptions, and published reports — ensuring alignment with methodology, sector frameworks, and evidentiary standards.
  

  

Stakeholder & Market Engagement

* Engage with external parties alongside senior team members, communicating complex analysis clearly and with credibility.
* Craft client- and executive-ready narratives that translate data, research, and analysis into clear, actionable stories.
* Build trusted stakeholder relationships through collaborative, adaptable, and analytically confident delivery.
  

  

Risk Management and Operating

* Ensure adherence to methodology, confidentiality requirements, and data governance standards; escalate issues early with clear options and recommendations to protect analytical integrity.
* Embed responsible, governed AI use into day-to-day workflows, using only approved tools and data while protecting confidential information at all times.
* Support the design, testing, and rollout of controlled automation and AI-assisted workflows, contributing to guardrail definitions that distinguish what can be automated from what must remain human-led.
  

  

**Compensation/Benefits Information (US Candidates)**

S&P Global states that the anticipated base salary range for this position is $100,000 to $154,000 USD. Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual's geographic location, as well as experience level, skill set, training, licenses and certifications. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan. This role is eligible to receive additional S&P Global benefits. For more information on the benefits we provide to our employees, please click here .

  
  

**What We're Looking For**

Required Skills and Experience:

* An S&P Global employee at this level would typically have 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in corporate credit analysis, financial analysis, or a related field.
* Demonstrated credit, financial, and risk analysis skills, with the ability to connect key drivers to forward-looking risk views and actionable credit opinions.
* Practical experience embedding AI tools, large language models (LLMs), or automation into analytical workflows to improve productivity and analytical insight.
* Proficiency in analytical tools, with a willingness to learn data and automation platforms that support AI-enabled workflows.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex analysis into concise, evidence-based narratives for senior stakeholders and rating committees.
* High standards for quality, traceability, and governance, with sound judgment on the responsible use of AI in a controlled analytical environment.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple credits and competing priorities, delivering high-quality work with limited oversight.
  

  

Preferred or Helpful Experience:

* Coaching or mentoring experience that has contributed to improved team capability, consistency, or the adoption of shared analytical standards.
* Experience contributing to process improvement, automation design, or the rollout of AI-assisted workflows.

Running a large, fast-growing, and high-performing network of public charter schools takes a village - families, children, teachers, staff and faculty, advocates, and supporters alike. When you join SA, you play a part in giving every student who walks through our doors a fair shot at reaching his or her potential.

**About the Role**

### **The Senior Payroll Analyst leads the execution, audit, and continuous improvement of multi-state payroll operations for a complex, diverse workforce. Positioned as a technical lead working alongside payroll associates and reporting into HR and Finance leadership, this senior role serves as the primary Subject Matter Expert (SME) for both ADP Workforce Now and Workday Payroll platforms. By maintaining rigorous alignment with multi-state tax regulations, driving automated system optimizations, and leading complex cross-functional initiatives, this role safeguards organizational compliance and financial integrity at scale.**

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Lead multi-state payroll operations:** Oversee the end-to-end processing, validation, and execution of complex bi-weekly, semi-monthly, and monthly payrolls across all employment types using ADP Workforce Now and Workday Payroll.
* **Drive financial integrity & reconciliations:** Direct advanced pre- and post-payroll audits, monthly general ledger account reconciliations, and journal entry preparations to ensure complete data accuracy and compliance with internal controls.
* **Architect & optimize system configurations:** Serve as the lead SME for ADP and Workday Payroll, driving platform setup, workflow automations, third-party integrations, and system updates to maximize operational efficiency.
* **Manage regulatory compliance & audits:** Direct multi-state tax compliance, manage quarterly/year-end government filings (including 941s and W-2s), and serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external payroll audits.
* **Partner cross-functionally on strategic projects:** Collaborate with HR, Finance, IT, and external vendors to manage high-level escalations and lead initiatives such as M&A integrations and policy rollouts.
* **Mentor team members & establish SOPs:** Develop comprehensive standard operating procedures (SOPs), maintain functional documentation, and provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior payroll team members.
  

**Qualifications**

* 7 to 10+ years of progressive multi-state payroll processing and administration experience in complex organizations.
* Advanced hands-on proficiency and administrative experience with ADP Workforce Now.
* Deep functional and technical expertise in Workday Payroll, including system configuration, custom reporting, and integration management.
* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Human Resources, or a related field (or equivalent combination of education and experience).

**Competencies**

* **Strategic System Ownership:** Leverages deep expertise in ADP and Workday to streamline technical workflows, automate manual processes, and architect scalable payroll rules.
* **Analytical & Audit Leadership:** Applies rigorous detail and systematic problem-solving to uncover complex payroll discrepancies, audit general ledger activity, and ensure financial accuracy.
* **Regulatory & Tax Mastery:** Maintains authoritative knowledge of federal, state, and local labor laws and tax regulations, keeping organizational operations continuously audit-ready.
* **Cross-Functional Influence & Mentorship:** Builds collaborative relationships with leaders across HR, Finance, and IT while serving as a trusted technical mentor to team members.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Every defect whether damaged, defective, missorted package or item has a cost story behind it, and you'll be the one uncovering it and quantifying it so you can drive the fix. Amazon's Central Operations Finance team is looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to serve as a trusted finance partner for Defect Cost Controllership (DCC), supporting operational and functional leaders across the network.  
  
The NACF DCC finance team provides cost controllership and project return on investment alongside financial insights for end-to-end defect reduction processes and initiatives across the supply chain. This role will directly influence controllership over defect costs spanning damages, concessions, and missorts, driving measurable cost reduction across fulfillment centers. Our team translates operational KPIs into financial impact so stakeholders have the most current and reliable information to make the best possible decisions for Amazon.  
  
As DCC expands its scope and takes on end-to-end defect reduction workstreams, we need a Senior Financial Analyst to help scale our controllership and cost insights capabilities. The team is investing in automated defect cost attribution and expanded reporting coverage while building new financial models to support warehouse damages initiatives.  
  
You'll work with SQL, Excel, and financial systems like SAP to build models and mine large-scale data while automating reporting. This role sits within the NACF Finance organization and partners closely with operations, Retail & FBA business partners, and customer service finance teams. Your time will be split between deep analytical work, building forecasts, cost bridges, and ROI models, and collaborative sessions with cross-functional stakeholders to align on strategy and present findings to senior leadership.  
  
There is significant room to grow in this role. You'll gain exposure to senior leaders and deep expertise across multiple cost domains, plus the opportunity to shape how DCC approaches financial controllership as the team scales.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Own end-to-end financial planning cycles including forecast modeling, variance bridging, network partnership, and presentations to senior leadership.
* Analyze large-scale quantitative data to build meaningful reports that drive defect cost reduction strategy and business improvement.
* Validate project financials to ensure accurate return-on-investment insights and track financial impact against budget baselines.
* Partner with senior stakeholders to align on cost strategy, challenge assumptions with data, and communicate financial insights clearly across audiences.
* Build and automate scalable processes that improve efficiency across finance workflows related to defect costs.

  
A day in the life  
The DCC team focuses on finance controllership, cost savings, and end-to-end defect cost reduction across North America Customer Fulfillment. Your primary focus will be on workstreams that identify opportunities leading to cost reduction and process improvement that strengthen financial controllership. You'll also own project financial validations and return-on-investment analyses while tracking financial impact on budget baselines. The team plays a key role in decision making and developing financial insights as part of monthly and quarterly business reviews, leading cost business reviews, and providing ad-hoc analysis on large or ambiguous deliverables. Recent projects have ranged from building automated cost bridges for monthly business reviews to quantifying the financial impact of new defect reduction pilots across the network.  
  
About the team  
The DCC team supports multiple teams across North America Customer Fulfillment and collaborates with NA Quality, Customer Service, and end-to-end financial controllership. In cases of worldwide workstreams, the team collaborates with business partners across the globe. What sets this team apart is the breadth of exposure. You'll work across every major defect category in the fulfillment network, partnering with operators and finance leaders alike to turn cost data into action.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of finance, accounting, or related analytical field experience
* Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, tax, economics, or a related analytical field
* Experience with advanced use of SQL for data mining and business intelligence

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)
* MBA, or CPA
* Experience in financial modeling, P&L management or analysis
* 3+ years of identifying, leading, and executing opportunities to improve, automate, standardize or simplify finance or business tools and processes experience
* Experience participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results
* Experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis

Our FP&A team sits at the center of the organization and is actively involved with all major strategic decisions. In this role, you will serve as a key financial partner to our Technology organization, owning the planning, forecasting and reporting for technology spend – including software, cloud infrastructure, and IT consulting – and helping the business understand the return on our technology investments. The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. It’s therefore essential that this role meets our high standard of ethics, honesty, transparency and compliance.

**In this role you will get to:**

  

* Act as an embedded financial partner to the CTO and Technology leadership team, serving as the connection between Finance rigor and Technology execution

**Who you are:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting or other quantitative discipline
* Minimum 7 years of related professional experience; FP&A experience required. Experience supporting a technology organization, or working with software and cloud cost data, is a plus
* Proven track record of critical thinking, performing comprehensive analysis, synthesizing data and presenting insights in a clear and concise way

* Demonstrated ability to multitask and meet deadlines within a fast-paced environment
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, coordinate the efforts of others, and work well with people at a wide range of levels

* The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics is essential.

The Bureau of Environmental Surveillance and Policy (BESP) in EH works to ground Health Department programs and policy in science and law to support a healthy and equitable natural, built, and occupational environment for all New Yorkers. We promote environmental health through legal and data-driven program support, using innovative methods to track environmental determinants of health with a focus on New Yorkers disproportionately impacted by environmental risk. We share data and research findings to encourage evidence-based decision making, and partner with communities in community science and outreach to address stakeholder concerns and empower residents.
  
  
The GIS Analyst supports field data collection for programs across the Division of Environmental Health including building and maintaining tools such as ESRI’s Survey123 and Field Maps for inspectional staff in the Bureau of Food Safety and other bureaus. Reporting to the Director of GIS in Environmental Health, the GIS Analyst trains field staff on these tools, reviews incoming field data for quality and accuracy, and works across the broader ArcGIS platform, including ArcGIS Online and ArcGIS Pro, to support mapping and analysis needs. The GIS Analyst also uses Python and ArcPy to automate recurring GIS processes and improve the efficiency of data workflows.

With over $200 billion of client capital invested across hedge funds, private equity, private credit, real estate, and direct investments/co-investments, the Global Alternatives Investment Solutions team delivers a “best in class” platform for sourcing and accessing differentiated alternative investment opportunities for institutional, private banking, and wealth management clients.

Within Global Alternative Investment Solutions (“GAIS”), Private Credit Solutions is a long-tenured, multi-manager platform with nearly $50bn of capital committed, 24 investment professionals, and deep connectivity across the private credit ecosystem, including 150+ GP relationships and 80+ LP investments since inception, reflecting 18+ years of dedicated private credit investing.

As a Private Credit Solutions Investments Analyst within GAIS at JPMorgan Chase & Co's Asset & Wealth Management division, you will be responsible for supporting sourcing, underwriting, and monitoring private investment funds and co-investments. You will have the opportunity to work closely with other Alternatives teams across GAIS, attend meetings with prospective and existing fund managers, and build specific knowledge of private markets. Morgan and Chase brands. J.P. Morgan Asset & Wealth Management delivers industry-leading investment management and private banking solutions.
