new_jobs.title: Quantitative Investment Analyst – SAA
new_jobs.description:
Talcott Financial Group\* is an international life insurance company committed to providing comprehensive risk solutions to its customers. Whether it’s providing peace of mind for policyholders approaching retirement, or helping insurers solve complex risk and capital challenges, Talcott delivers practical solutions that support long-term stability for policyholders and clients.
  
  
Talcott offers the strength of an established organization with the mindset and approach of a modern platform. The enterprise is supported by a proven track record of well-executed transactions, investment-grade financial strength ratings, and strong financial position, with over $136 billion in assets under management. Talcott also benefits from a strategic partnership with Sixth Street, a leading global investment firm managing over $135 billion in assets.
  
  
Talcott’s approach to business is disciplined, transparent, and multi-channel, spanning retail annuities, block and flow reinsurance, and legal entity acquisitions. We have offices in Bermuda, the Cayman Islands, Connecticut, New York, and North Carolina.
  
  
Position Overview
  
We are seeking an Investment Analyst to join our Strategic Asset Allocation (SAA) Design team in a new role. The successful candidate will design and build the analytical tools that power our SAA process in developing asset allocation strategies and supporting the asset deployment planning. We are looking for a candidate who can use AI-assisted tools to deliver well-validated working models that can be put into production to support dynamic business needs. The role suits a technically strong, fast learner who is excited by the intersection of quantitative finance, insurance asset management and AI.
  
  
Primary Responsibilities
  

* Scope of $50bn+ of general account assets: Include legal entities in US, Bermuda and Cayman
* Portfolio Design & Optimization: Build best in class SAA tools and analytics that support portfolio optimization, scenario analysis to evaluate trade-offs between risk, return, and capital efficiency and asset deployment planning in support of new business, deal pricing and the onboarding of new mandates.
* Model Understanding & Validation: Develop a working understanding of the underlying SAA, optimization and ALM models to integrate into new model builds.
* AI-Assisted Development: Using AI as a core part of the build process while ensuring every tool is robust, validated and technically sound.
* Partnership with Investment Analytics: Work closely with the Investment Analytics team on model design and ensure integration into broader investment platform.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate within Investments and with Corporate Development, ERM, and Actuarial teams to ensure that the solutions developed accurately incorporate capital market assumptions, liability characteristics, and enterprise objectives.
* Governance & Reporting: Assist in preparing materials for investment committees and senior leadership, articulating SAA rationale, tool methodology and relevant insights.

Qualifications
  

* Experience: 2-7 years of experience in a quantitative finance role within investment management; a graduate degree in quantitative finance, computer science, mathematics or a related field may be considered in place of experience. Progression towards CFA and/or ASA/FSA is a plus. Familiarity with insurance asset management, ALM and various regulatory capital frameworks strongly preferred.
* Investments & Capital Markets Knowledge: Strong quantitative and analytical skills with an understanding of portfolio theory, optimization, capital markets and risk modeling and knowledge of insurance products, ALM, liability-driven investing and fixed income.
* Technical Skills: Programming expertise in MS SQL, Python or another programming language required.. Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills. Familiarity with Power BI and Microsoft Fabric is a plus.
* AI Proficiency: Demonstrated hands-on use of AI or agentic AI tools to build working prototypes, or clear evidence of the ability to adopt them rapidly. Understands the limits of AI-generated output and how to specify, test and validate it.
* Learning Agility: Strong aptitude and genuine interest in learning new domains quickly – including SAA, ALM and insurance investment concepts.
* Communication Skills: Strong general and technical communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex financial and mathematical concepts to a wide range of stakeholders, and to document models and tools clearly for users and validators.
* Problem-Solving & Creativity: Demonstrated creativity and excellent problem-solving abilities in analytical environments.
* Teamwork & Independence: Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to a collaborative team setting.

**Compensation:**  
This range represents the minimum and maximum annual base salary we reasonably expect to pay for this role at the time of posting. The actual base pay could vary and may be above or below the listed range. The base pay is based on factors including but not limited to experience, competence, and demonstration of proficiencies essential for the role. The base pay is just one component of Talcott’s total annual compensation for employees. Other compensation may include annual bonuses, long-term incentives and recognition.
  
  

* This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without current or future visa sponsorship.

new_jobs.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
new_jobs.description:
**About Metergy Solutions, LLC. (“Metergy”)**

Metergy has the energy, rapid growth and excitement of a startup, together with a rock-solid, recession-proof business that has a 45 year track record. We’re a technology company that drives huge carbon emission reductions. This is a once-in-a-career opportunity.

As one of North America’s most experienced submetering providers, Metergy has brought turnkey solutions to clients for over 45 years. Metergy supplies, installs and remotely reads meters to measure individual suite consumption of electricity, water, gas, and thermal energy in multi-residential and commercial buildings, and bills and collects for the cost of commodities and administrative charges for the services provided. The business model allows for long-term recurring revenue through an innovative Submetering as a Service (SaaS) model. Submetering is proven to reduce in-suite energy consumption by 40%, driving decarbonization efforts for Metergy’s clients. This performance has enabled Metergy to issue green bonds and obtain green financing.

Positioned as the #1 submeter provider in the New York and Canadian markets, and one of the largest in North America, Metergy has more than 900,000 contracted meters, issues over 4M utility bills annually and has over 500 team members. Metergy is a portfolio company of Brookfield Infrastructure Partners. Brookfield is one of the world’s largest investors, owners and operators of infrastructure assets across the utilities, transport, energy, data and sustainable resources sectors. This sponsorship provides Metergy with access to large-scale capital, infrastructure investment expertise and global reach.

**Our Mission**

Provide building owners and occupants with accurate and reliable utility consumption data through market-leading expertise in turnkey submetering and billing, while fostering a workplace with inspired team members empowered to do more good.

At Metergy, we don’t just believe in our people; we champion them. When individuals feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow, incredible things happen. That’s why we’re thrilled to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work** for the **third** **consecutive year**! This achievement reflects our unwavering commitment to building a workplace that’s respectful, inclusive, and high-performing.

Come be part of a team that leads with **passion**, thrives on **positivity**, and delivers with **precision**. We’re proud of who we are and even prouder of where we’re headed.

**The Opportunity:**

The Business Intelligence Analyst will support the Strategy and Analytics team with the execution of detailed analysis and creation of reports, dashboards and visualizations that provide the business with critical information to make informed decisions. The individual will use various tools and techniques to identify trends, patterns, and insights, working with data from various sources, ensuring data quality and integrity, and collaborating with various groups and stakeholders across the business to understand information requirements as well as maintain data integrity/perform audits in our data platform.

Utilize business intelligence and reporting software, database tools, Microsoft Excel, and Office automation to design, build, assess, maintain, improve, and distribute dashboards and reports, combine data, and present accurate information.

  

### **Responsibilities**

* Distill complex data and relationships into clear, concise charts and visualizations, support ad hoc data requests and analysis.

* Design data models to extract data from operational databases and transform the data to easily understood business views.

* Gather and process raw data at scale (including writing scripts, web scraping, calling API’s, writing SQL queries, etc.)

* Process unstructured data into a form suitable for analysis- then do the analysis.

* Automate manual processes.

* Navigate CRM and other systems to build reporting, ensure consistency and compliance across the departments.

* Develop management monthly KPI’s/reports and BI dashboards for stakeholders across all business functions: technology, operations, field, billing etc

* Perform in-depth analysis to identify key business risks and opportunities and make recommendations to improve overall profitability

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Comp Sci/ MIS/ Data Analytics/ Math or Statistics (or any analytical/data driven discipline)

* 0-2 years of experience working within business intelligence (Co-op/Internships included)

* High Proficiency in data modelling and analysis with demonstrated acumen using the following tools Excel, PowerBI, Python & SQL

* Strong SQL experience is a must with knowledge of relational databases, and ability to build and maintain views

* Meticulous attention to detail and commitment to accuracy

* Data driven analytical skills, knowledge and/or experience related to financial analysis

* Excellent problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to addressing challenges

* Ability to prioritize and adapt to changing demands and deadlines, are essential

* Ability to conduct basic statistical and correlation analysis to identify patterns and trends.

* Excellent skills in Excel, R/Python, SQL

* Experienced with BI Tools such as Power BI / Tableau / SAP (Power BI Preferred)

* Creativity, relationship building skills and dedication are all highly desirable

Gather and document business requirements and relevant information to effectively triage, troubleshoot, and resolve system issues in collaboration with technical teams. Ensure issues are tracked through completion. Identify opportunities to improve platform functionality, streamline workflows, and enhance the user experience.

  

**3.** **Performance Analytics & Reporting**

Develop, maintain, and enhance Power BI dashboards, Salesforce reports, and analytical tools that provide actionable insights into Commercial performance. Monitor key performance indicators, evaluate sales execution and activation effectiveness, and conduct trend and root cause analyses to identify performance gaps and opportunities for improvement. Ensure reporting aligns with business priorities and supports informed decision-making across the organization.

**4.** **Data Stewardship & Quality Assurance**

Support data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across Salesforce and Power BI. Investigate data discrepancies, identify underlying issues, and coordinate with Data and IT teams on resolution. Promote data quality standards and best practices to ensure reliable reporting and maintain confidence in the underlying information.

**5.** **Data Analytics Best Practices**

Promote a data-driven culture by sharing analytical best practices, collaborating with other analysts/specialists, and helping stakeholders build their understanding of available tools and insights. Contribute to MHUSA's broader analytics community and support the adoption of consistent reporting methodologies and performance measurement standards across teams.

**The Company**

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

**Job Summary:**

PayPal's Corporate Development team is looking for a Senior Analyst to help identify, evaluate, and execute acquisitions that advance the strategic and financial objectives of the company and its business divisions. This role is for someone who has built a strong foundation in investment banking and wants to move from advising on transactions to owning them, seeing a deal through from first idea to signed agreement to integration.

* 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

* Background in fintech, consumer technology, or consumer financial services, whether through banking coverage, investing, corporate strategy, or an operating role
* Strong financial modeling and valuation skills, including DCF, trading comparables, precedent transactions, and accretion/dilution analysis

Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Senior Analyst, Business DevelopmentOverview  
The Global Partnerships team is responsible for cultivating and managing Mastercard’s most strategic relationships with key players across the payments ecosystem. The team works with global leaders in technology, e-commerce and financial services to build and scale solutions across acceptance, issuing and co-brand partnerships, payments services and emerging commerce capabilities.  
  
Join an agile, high-performing team within Mastercard’s Global Acceptance vertical, focused on growing the Global Acquiring business with leading centralized global acquirers and commerce enablers.  
  
These customers are central to Mastercard’s acceptance strategy and operate across multiple markets, channels and business models. The team works closely with regional stakeholders, product teams and customer partners to defend and grow revenue, deepen relationships and execute priority strategic initiatives.  
  
Reporting to the Vice President, Business Development, this Sr. Analyst role will provide hands-on support across a portfolio of key strategic accounts. The role will work closely with senior account leads to help manage day-to-day customer engagement, coordinate internal stakeholders, progress commercial opportunities and ensure strong execution of strategic account priorities.  
  
The role offers the opportunity to build deep expertise in global account management, business development, acquiring, commerce platforms and emerging payments, while gaining exposure to complex global customers and cross-functional initiatives across Mastercard.

Success in this role means becoming a trusted and highly effective partner to the global enablers team and the customers they manage, helping the team deliver a consistently strong customer experience and execute strategic priorities with pace and discipline.  
You will help the team:

**About the Role:**

**Grade Level (for internal use):**

11

Job Description

**The Role**

As a Cyber Incident Response Analyst, you will be part of the Cyber Defence team that develops and oversees the company's security program, ensuring S&P Global is protected from existing and emerging threats. In close partnership with Security Operations and Threat Intelligence, you will detect, analyze, and decisively respond to security incidents, enrich investigations with timely intelligence, and help drive proactive defences. While based in the UK, you will support response and intelligence needs globally.

Candidates should have a genuine interest in cyber security and a strong grasp of attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs). This role requires a detail-oriented, critical thinker who understands how adversaries exploit systems, networks, and people—and how to respond. Experience applying threat intelligence to investigations and to improve detections is highly desirable.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and triage response to cybersecurity events and conduct forensic analysis across endpoints, networks, cloud, and SaaS.
* Integrate threat intelligence into investigations (e.g., enrich IOCs, map activity to MITRE ATT&CK, identify likely threat actors/TTPs, and assess potential impact).
* Understand the threat landscape through collaboration with industry peers, FS-ISAC, trust groups, and commercial/open-source intelligence, translating insights into actionable recommendations.
* Develop, maintain, and operationalize Incident Response playbooks and SOPs; include PIRs (Priority Intelligence Requirements), collection plans, and feedback loops to refine detections.
* Work closely with the SOC to investigate incidents and deliver containment, remediation, and root cause analysis; produce high-quality intel-informed incident reports.
* Create and tune detections (e.g., SIEM/SOAR, EDR) using intelligence signals (TTPs, behaviors, YARA/Sigma where applicable).
* Produce and present consumable intelligence outputs (e.g., flash alerts, threat overviews, executive briefs) tailored to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Contribute to vulnerability/threat surfacing (e.g., emerging CVEs, exploit trends) and advise on risk-based prioritization.
* Deliver actionable incident and hunting metrics to management; assess detection coverage and recommend improvements.
* Follow the end-to-end incident response lifecycle and support post-incident lessons learned with intelligence-driven enhancements.
* Build an understanding of key S&P technology, systems, and business practices to contextualize threats and drive pragmatic defenses.
* Participate in information-sharing activities (e.g., FS-ISAC submissions) in line with TLP and legal/compliance requirements.

**Required Qualifications**

* Working knowledge of common cyber attacks, tools, and attacker tradecraft; ability to map activity to MITRE ATT&CK and articulate likely TTPs.
* Demonstrated experience handling security events in critical environments and applying intelligence to accelerate triage and response.
* Experience analyzing system, application, and cloud/SaaS logs to investigate security and operational issues; comfort enriching with IOCs and behaviours.
* Hands-on experience with a SIEM (Splunk preferred) for investigations, alert creation, reporting, and threat hunting.
* Ability to produce clear, actionable intel and incident reports, including executive-ready summaries and visuals.
* Familiarity with threat intel workflows: collection planning, source evaluation, indicator lifecycle, PIRs, TLP, and feedback loops to detections.
* Experience with one or more TIPs or intel data sources (e.g., MISP, OpenCTI, Recorded Future) and STIX/TAXII concepts.
* 3+ years of information security experience with a focus on incident response, threat hunting, or threat intelligence.
* Excellent communication skills for varied business and technical audiences; strong presentation skills.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment; passion for cyber security.
* Advanced knowledge of network protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP) and operating systems.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in the financial services industry.
* Familiarity with threat hunting techniques (hypothesis-driven, ATT&CK-aligned, behavior-based).
* Windows and Linux administration tools and concepts.
* Understanding of threat actors and the cybercrime ecosystem, including initial access vectors, monetization paths, and supply-chain/SaaS attack patterns.
* Exposure to malware/TTP analysis at a functional level (family identification, persistence/discovery behaviors) and creation of detections (e.g., Sigma/YARA) is a plus.
* Experience producing finished intelligence products (tactical through executive) and briefing senior stakeholders.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., GCTI, GCFA/GCFR, GCIH, FOR578) or equivalent experience.
* Familiarity with information-sharing standards and practices (FS-ISAC, TLP) and legal/compliance considerations.
* Knowledge of cloud provider threat models and telemetry (AWS, Azure, GCP, M365/SaaS).
* Second language and/or geopolitical awareness for actor context is a plus.

**Compensation/Benefits Information:**

In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan. This role is not eligible for additional compensation such as an annual incentive bonus or sales commission plan. **About NYC Health + Hospitals**
--------------------------------

  

NYC Health + Hospitals is the largest public health care system in the United States. We provide essential outpatient, inpatient and home-based services to more than one million New Yorkers every year across the city’s five boroughs. Our large health system consists of ambulatory centers, acute care centers, post-acute care/long-term care, rehabilitation programs, Home Care, and Correctional Health Services. Our diverse workforce is uniquely focused on empowering New Yorkers.

At NYC Health + Hospitals, our mission is to deliver high quality care health services, without exception. Every employee takes a person-centered approach that exemplifies the ICARE values (Integrity, Compassion, Accountability, Respect, and Excellence) through empathic communication and partnerships between all persons.

**Work Shifts**
---------------

  

**9:00 A.M – 5:00 P.M**

**Duties & Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

  

**Purpose of Position**:
  
  
Under supervision, implements newly designed systems and parallel systems; revises existing systems, methods, procedures and designs. Performs analysis and modifies systems, procedures and forms to effect improvements, increase effectiveness in process flows and optimization of Corporate productivity.
  
  
**Examples of Typical Tasks**:
  
  
1. Studies, reviews and analyzes existing systems, methods, procedures and projects to determine whether systems meet the operational needs of the Corporation.
  
  
2. Prepares and modifies flow charts, diagrams, reports and other documentation necessary for systems design and modification.
  
  
3. Participates in the training of staff in the implementation of new programs and systems design.
  
  
4. Prepares manuals of systems and procedures, reviews and modifies existing manuals.
  
  
5. Recommends improvements and/or modifications of existing systems in terms of problems, bottlenecks and inadequate utilization of resources.
  
  
6. Implements the development of approval systems and subsystems.
  
  
7. Designs and implements approval parallel systems to minimize operational problems.
  
  
8. Maintains, modifies, improves and monitors existing operational systems, standards of performance, quality of controls and progress of assigned projects with a view towards computer applications.
  
  
9. Utilizes industrial engineering techniques and/or administrative management techniques to establish performance standards and input data, and analyzes alternative means of deriving input data and recommends the optimal method.

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

  

1. A Baccalaureate Degree in a relevant field from an accredited college or university; and,
  
2. One year of experience in business, government, hospital, educational institute or non-profit organization in analysis, development and implementation of systems, methods and procedures, management information development and data coordination. Familiarity with EDP applications and data processing programs; or,
  
3. A Masters Degree in Management, Business Administration, Hospital Administration Management, Public Administration, Accounting or relevant field from an accredited college or university; or,
  
4. A satisfactory combination of education, training and experience.

**Department Preferences**
--------------------------

  

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities and other Requirements:

* Contact Center Operations and Quality Auditing
* Quality Evaluation Processes and Software
* Ambulatory Care Front Desk Operations and Scheduling
* Self-starter and ability to work independently.
* Strong organizational skills, meets deadlines and carries out duties efficiently.
* Successfully prioritizes competing tasks
* Ability to analyze and identify agent trending
* Effective communication (written and oral).
* Ability to overcome organizational resistance to change.
* Experience with creating or compiling reports using various sources of data.
* Strong Leadership Skills
* Must be extremely detail oriented with the ability to collaborate with Operations to create thorough corrective and preventative plans.
* 1-3 Years Healthcare or Contact Center Quality background preferred.
* 1-3 Years Contact Center experience preferred
* Calabrio (or similar Quality Evaluation Software)
* Epic
* MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)

**Benefits**
------------

  

NYC Health and Hospitals offers a competitive benefits package that includes:

* Comprehensive Health Benefits for employees hired to work 20+ hrs. per week
* Retirement Savings and Pension Plans
* Paid Holidays and Vacation in accordance with employees' Collectively bargained contracts
* Loan Forgiveness Programs for eligible employees
* College tuition discounts and professional development opportunities
* College Savings Program
* Union Benefits for eligible titles
* Multiple employee discounts programs
* Commuter Benefits Programs

**How To Apply**
----------------

  

If you wish to apply for this position, please apply online by clicking the "Apply for Job" button.

new_jobs.title: Risk Management Automation Solution Analyst
new_jobs.description:
**Position Title**

Risk Management Automation Solution Analyst

**Location**

Hicksville, NY 11801

**Job Summary**

The Risk Management Automation Solution Analyst role exists to design, develop, and implement automated and AI-driven solutions that enhance the efficiency, accuracy, and visibility of risk management processes, controls, and reporting. The role partners with risk managers and business stakeholders to identify and transform manual workflows into scalable, data-driven solutions - leveraging tools such as Python, SQL, machine learning frameworks, RPA platforms, and data visualization technologies to support anomaly detection, predictive analytics, and regulatory reporting.

**Job Responsibilities:**

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Design, develop, and implement automated solutions to streamline risk management workflows, monitoring, and reporting.
* Build and maintain AI/ML models to support risk division in repetitive activities (e.g., anomaly detection, predictive analytics).
* Develop dashboards and automated reporting tools to improve visibility into risks and emerging trends.
* Collaborate with risk managers and business stakeholders to identify manual processes suitable for automation and prioritize solution development.
* Integrate data from multiple sources to create unified, reliable datasets for risk analysis and regulatory reporting.
* Evaluate and recommend emerging AI tools, platforms, and technologies that can enhance the team's capabilities.
* Document solution designs, code, and processes to ensure transparency, reproducibility, and auditability.
* Support governance and validation efforts for AI/ML models in alignment with AI frameworks.
* Uses independent judgement and discretion to make model development decisions.
* Analyzes and resolves problems pertaining to model performance issues.

**ADDITIONAL ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* Performs special projects, and additional duties and responsibilities as required.
* Consistently adheres to regulatory and compliance policies and standards linked to the job as listed and complete required compliance trainings. Accountable to maintain compliance with applicable federal, state and local laws and regulations.

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**

**Required Qualifications:**

* Education level required: Undergraduate Degree (4 years or equivalent) Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical field.
* Minimum experience required: 2+ Years (including internships, academic projects, or freelance work) in one or more of the following: Python, R, SQL, or similar programming languages, Machine learning / AI frameworks, Robotic Process Automation (RPA) tools (e.g., Power Automate, Automation Anywhere), Data visualization tools (e.g., PowerBI, PowerAutomate).

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Exposure to banking, financial services, or risk management concepts.
* Familiarity with regulatory frameworks (e.g., OCC guidelines, FDIC regulations, Basel standards).
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and API integrations.
* Knowledge of generative AI applications (e.g., LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG architectures).
* Understanding of model risk management principles and AI governance best practices.
* Relevant certifications such as AWS Cloud Practitioner, Azure AI Fundamentals, or FRM/PRM.

**Job Competencies:**

* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with high attention to detail and accuracy.
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Ability to clearly articulate, in writing or orally, ideas, analytic insights, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences, including an executive audience.
* An ability to identify key problems, conduct in-depth research, and articulate well-reasoned solutions.
* Ability to analyze, collect, research and understand complex data.
* Demonstrates a strong ability to build and maintain effective relationships with stakeholders by communicating clearly, engaging in proactive collaboration, and leveraging cross functional insights. Aligns relationship building efforts with enterprise goals to accelerate performance and drive strategic results.
* Builds trusted client relationships, whether internal or external, by identifying needs and delivering tailored solutions to enhance the overall client experience.
* Fosters or supports a positive work culture and productive work environment, displaying importance of effective relationships with customers and stakeholders.
* Travel requirements: Not required.
* Physical demands (ADA): No unusual physical exertion is involved.

**Flagstar is an Equal Opportunity Employer - Vets/Disabled**

We are committed to providing clear and accurate compensation information in accordance with applicable laws. Actual starting base pay will be determined based on location, experience, and other non-discriminatory factors permitted by law. Total compensation may also include variable incentives, bonuses, commissions, or other awards as outlined in the offer of employment. Flagstar provides teammates access to a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, as well as a comprehensive leave program. Please click the following link for detailed information: *Benefits | Flagstar Bank*

Pay Range

$66,538.50 - $111,484.00

new_jobs.description:
Job highlights

* Full time
* New York, New York, USA
* Finance

Job IDR200001825Closing date01/01/2027Last Updated15/10/2026

**Glencore**, headquartered in Baar, Switzerland is one of the world's leading integrated producers and marketers of commodities that industries around the world need. Glencore has worldwide activities in the production, sourcing, processing, refining, transporting, storage, financing and supply of metals and minerals, energy products, and agricultural products. We strive to be a reliable and competitive partner in the markets in which we serve and to support our customers and suppliers at each stage of their expansion and development.

**Glencore Ltd**, a US-based branch of Glencore AG, is a wholly owned subsidiary of Glencore International AG, where it employees approximately 300 people.

  

**Structured Finance Analyst (New York, NY)**

  

**Department:** Oil Project and Structured Finance (OPSF)

  

**Overview:**

  

The Structured Finance Analyst will support Glencore's global oil trading activities by assisting the Oil & Gas Project and Structured Finance Department in executing complex transactions related to M&A and debt financing. This role will focus on opportunities in both North and South America and will involve collaboration with trading desks to identify and structure bankable transactions.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

**Market Analysis:**

* Track market trends, pricing dynamics and regulatory developments for financing structures in the upstream, midstream, and downstream space.
* Conduct market monitoring and networking with corporates, investors, and advisors (including legal counsel).

**Transaction Evaluation:**

* Evaluate investment opportunities across the oil & gas value chain, with responsibility for cash flow modelling, scenario analysis, risk/return assessments, and due diligence support.
* Develop and maintain financial models for structured transactions, including acquisitions, commodity-linked financings, asset-backed securitizations, and project finance structures.

**Transaction Structuring and Execution:**

* Support deal structuring and execution by preparing internal investment memos, presentations, and term sheets.
* Coordinate internal and external stakeholders, manage deal documentation, and facilitate negotiations.
* Collaborate with external legal advisers to assess risk profiles, legal structures, and enforcement mechanisms involved in transactions.
* Work alongside other team members to structure and syndicate transactions, ensuring they align with Glencore's marketing division strategy.

**Transaction Monitoring:**

* Collaborate with legal, operations, and risk teams to support ongoing monitoring of structured deals.
* Manage and update models, providing ongoing performance analysis.

**Stakeholder Engagement:**

* Maintain and expand relationships with banks, investors, and other key stakeholders to widen the pool of participants in financing transactions.
  

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 2-5 years of experience in investment banking, structured finance, M&A, or asset management, with experience in energy and/or infrastructure a plus.
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills with a keen understanding of financial modeling and transaction structuring and a proven track record in building complex financial models.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively liaise with various stakeholders.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.
* Proficient in Excel, Powerpoint, and financial databases; VBA, Python or SQL is a plus.
  

**Compensation:**

  

* The expected base salary ranges from $120,000 -$140,000. Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including relevant skills, training, experience, education, and, where applicable, certifications and licenses obtained. Market and organizational factors are also considered. In addition to salary and a generous employee benefits package, successful candidates are eligible to receive a discretionary bonus.

new_jobs.title: Senior Analyst - Corporate Ratings, New York
new_jobs.description:
**About the Role:**
===================

**Grade Level (for internal use):**

11

**The Team**

Credit Ratings is an integral part of S&P Global's Global Ratings Services, bringing together a diverse group of more than 1,400 analysts across key financial centers worldwide. The Corporates Ratings practice delivers forward-looking credit insights on a wide range of corporate entities, producing independent rating opinions that markets and investors rely on to understand how evolving risks affect financial stability and credit performance. The team provides analytical coverage of corporate issuers across the Transportation, Automotive, Aerospace & Defense, and Engineering & Construction sectors, monitoring industry trends, evaluating company performance and credit risk, and contributing to the ongoing assessment and maintenance of credit ratings.

  
  

**Responsibilities and Impact**

Impact

This role plays a key part in delivering the independent, rigorous credit analysis that underpins S&P Global Ratings' trusted, decision-ready intelligence. The Senior Analyst leads analysis for an assigned corporate portfolio, synthesizing complex financial and market data into clear, committee-ready rating opinions. By integrating AI-enabled tools with deep analytical expertise, the role drives productivity, quality, and consistency across the credit process — contributing to analysis that informs investors, issuers, and market participants globally.

  
  

Responsibilities

Team Contribution & Capability Building

* Provide day-to-day coaching and guidance to Research Assistants and Rating Analysts, building capability in credit analysis, data discipline, and analytical tooling while reinforcing values-driven behaviors.
* Drive consistency and scalability by codifying standard work and promoting the disciplined adoption of shared analytical practices across the team.
* Strengthen AI-enabled productivity by developing reusable assets and proposing lightweight automations that free capacity for higher-value human analysis and relationship work.
* Partner with senior team members and Data and Engineering colleagues to identify, design, and scale AI and automation use cases with governance built in from the outset.
  

  

Core Analytical & Delivery

* Lead end-to-end execution for assigned credits, ensuring high-quality analysis and timely delivery with clear accountability across priorities.
* Own ongoing surveillance for an assigned portfolio, synthesizing performance data, market signals, and peer context into decision-useful insights with clear risk implications.
* Support the embedding of AI and automation tools into analytical workflows, applying structured validation and analytical judgment to maintain the integrity and reliability of conclusions.
* Prepare and review key analytical outputs — including model inputs, metrics, assumptions, and published reports — ensuring alignment with methodology, sector frameworks, and evidentiary standards.
  

  

Stakeholder & Market Engagement

* Engage with external parties alongside senior team members, communicating complex analysis clearly and with credibility.
* Craft client- and executive-ready narratives that translate data, research, and analysis into clear, actionable stories.
* Build trusted stakeholder relationships through collaborative, adaptable, and analytically confident delivery.
  

  

Risk Management and Operating

* Ensure adherence to methodology, confidentiality requirements, and data governance standards; escalate issues early with clear options and recommendations to protect analytical integrity.
* Embed responsible, governed AI use into day-to-day workflows, using only approved tools and data while protecting confidential information at all times.
* Support the design, testing, and rollout of controlled automation and AI-assisted workflows, contributing to guardrail definitions that distinguish what can be automated from what must remain human-led.
  

  

**Compensation/Benefits Information (US Candidates)**

S&P Global states that the anticipated base salary range for this position is $100,000 to $154,000 USD. Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual's geographic location, as well as experience level, skill set, training, licenses and certifications. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan. This role is eligible to receive additional S&P Global benefits. For more information on the benefits we provide to our employees, please click here .

  
  

**What We're Looking For**

Required Skills and Experience:

* An S&P Global employee at this level would typically have 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in corporate credit analysis, financial analysis, or a related field.
* Demonstrated credit, financial, and risk analysis skills, with the ability to connect key drivers to forward-looking risk views and actionable credit opinions.
* Practical experience embedding AI tools, large language models (LLMs), or automation into analytical workflows to improve productivity and analytical insight.
* Proficiency in analytical tools, with a willingness to learn data and automation platforms that support AI-enabled workflows.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex analysis into concise, evidence-based narratives for senior stakeholders and rating committees.
* High standards for quality, traceability, and governance, with sound judgment on the responsible use of AI in a controlled analytical environment.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple credits and competing priorities, delivering high-quality work with limited oversight.
  

  

Preferred or Helpful Experience:

* Coaching or mentoring experience that has contributed to improved team capability, consistency, or the adoption of shared analytical standards.
* Experience contributing to process improvement, automation design, or the rollout of AI-assisted workflows.

Investment Banking

Investment Bank

344917BR

London, New York

Job Type

Full Time

Key responsibilities

Do you thrive on intellectual challenges and take pride in building robust, well-designed quantitative solutions? Are you interested in applying advanced quantitative methods to complex financial products for a firm with a truly global footprint? We're looking for an outstanding Quantitative Analyst who can:
  
  
Research, develop and enhance the valuation and risk management models and tools supporting Cross Asset Financing businesses, including Structured Financing and Fund Financing.
  
  
Apply quantitative techniques to model complex fund structures in bespoke Fund Financing facilities.
  
  
Apply advanced statistical techniques to develop prepayment and default models for securitized products.
  
  
Partner with other Quantitative Analytics (QA) teams to develop automated and scalable cross-asset solutions used by Trading, Structuring, and Sales.
  
  
Collaborate closely with Trading, Structuring, Risk, and Control functions to perform statistical analysis, develop valuation and risk methodologies, and support business decision-making.

Your Career Comeback

We are open to applications from career returners. Find out more about our program on ubs.com/careercomeback.

The team

The Credit Quantitative Analytics (QA) team is the Front Office group responsible for developing quantitative models, methodologies, and technology that support pricing and risk management for Credit businesses across the firm, including Credit Solutions, Flow Credit, Cross Asset Financing, Global Banking. The team’s models and infrastructure are used for quoting clients, risk managing trading positions, marking the firm’s books and records. The team works closely with Trading, Structuring, IT and control functions, as well as other QA teams such as Equities, FX, Rates and the central infrastructure team.

Your skills and experience

Strong academic background, preferably at the Master’s or PhD level, in a quantitative discipline such as Mathematics, Physics, Computational Finance, Engineering, or a related field.
  
  
Proficiency in one of the object-oriented programming languages such as C , C#, Java or Python, with the ability to develop robust and scalable quantitative solutions.
  
  
A solid foundation in quantitative finance and derivatives pricing, with knowledge of modern numerical and/or machine learning techniques.
  
  
Knowledge of securitized products, fixed income analytics, and complex fund structures is a plus.
  
  
Ability to apply AI and emerging technologies responsibly to improve business outcomes and operational efficiency.
  
  
Ability to communicate complex ideas in a fluent and articulate manner.
  
  
You’re curious to explore how AI can improve how we build, deliver and optimize workflows. You do this with sound judgment – validating outputs and aligning with policies, risk standard and ethical use.

About us

UBS is a leading and truly global wealth manager and the leading universal bank in Switzerland. We also provide diversified asset management solutions and focused investment banking capabilities. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, UBS is present in more than 50 markets around the globe.
  
We know that great work is never done alone. That’s why we place collaboration at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves. Want to find out more? Visit ubs.com/careers.

The expected salary for this role will be determined by relevant factors which may include but are not limited to, role-required experience, qualifications, education, location and skill level. ### **The Senior Payroll Analyst leads the execution, audit, and continuous improvement of multi-state payroll operations for a complex, diverse workforce. Positioned as a technical lead working alongside payroll associates and reporting into HR and Finance leadership, this senior role serves as the primary Subject Matter Expert (SME) for both ADP Workforce Now and Workday Payroll platforms. new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Every defect whether damaged, defective, missorted package or item has a cost story behind it, and you'll be the one uncovering it and quantifying it so you can drive the fix. Amazon's Central Operations Finance team is looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to serve as a trusted finance partner for Defect Cost Controllership (DCC), supporting operational and functional leaders across the network.  
  
The NACF DCC finance team provides cost controllership and project return on investment alongside financial insights for end-to-end defect reduction processes and initiatives across the supply chain. This role will directly influence controllership over defect costs spanning damages, concessions, and missorts, driving measurable cost reduction across fulfillment centers. Our team translates operational KPIs into financial impact so stakeholders have the most current and reliable information to make the best possible decisions for Amazon.  
  
As DCC expands its scope and takes on end-to-end defect reduction workstreams, we need a Senior Financial Analyst to help scale our controllership and cost insights capabilities. The team is investing in automated defect cost attribution and expanded reporting coverage while building new financial models to support warehouse damages initiatives.  
  
You'll work with SQL, Excel, and financial systems like SAP to build models and mine large-scale data while automating reporting. This role sits within the NACF Finance organization and partners closely with operations, Retail & FBA business partners, and customer service finance teams. Your time will be split between deep analytical work, building forecasts, cost bridges, and ROI models, and collaborative sessions with cross-functional stakeholders to align on strategy and present findings to senior leadership.  
  
There is significant room to grow in this role. You'll gain exposure to senior leaders and deep expertise across multiple cost domains, plus the opportunity to shape how DCC approaches financial controllership as the team scales.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Own end-to-end financial planning cycles including forecast modeling, variance bridging, network partnership, and presentations to senior leadership.
* Analyze large-scale quantitative data to build meaningful reports that drive defect cost reduction strategy and business improvement.
* Validate project financials to ensure accurate return-on-investment insights and track financial impact against budget baselines.
* Partner with senior stakeholders to align on cost strategy, challenge assumptions with data, and communicate financial insights clearly across audiences.
* Build and automate scalable processes that improve efficiency across finance workflows related to defect costs.

  
A day in the life  
The DCC team focuses on finance controllership, cost savings, and end-to-end defect cost reduction across North America Customer Fulfillment. Your primary focus will be on workstreams that identify opportunities leading to cost reduction and process improvement that strengthen financial controllership. You'll also own project financial validations and return-on-investment analyses while tracking financial impact on budget baselines. The team plays a key role in decision making and developing financial insights as part of monthly and quarterly business reviews, leading cost business reviews, and providing ad-hoc analysis on large or ambiguous deliverables. Recent projects have ranged from building automated cost bridges for monthly business reviews to quantifying the financial impact of new defect reduction pilots across the network.  
  
About the team  
The DCC team supports multiple teams across North America Customer Fulfillment and collaborates with NA Quality, Customer Service, and end-to-end financial controllership. In cases of worldwide workstreams, the team collaborates with business partners across the globe. What sets this team apart is the breadth of exposure. You'll work across every major defect category in the fulfillment network, partnering with operators and finance leaders alike to turn cost data into action.

------------------------

* 3+ years of finance, accounting, or related analytical field experience
* Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, tax, economics, or a related analytical field
* Experience with advanced use of SQL for data mining and business intelligence

----------------------------

* Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)
* MBA, or CPA
* Experience in financial modeling, P&L management or analysis
* 3+ years of identifying, leading, and executing opportunities to improve, automate, standardize or simplify finance or business tools and processes experience
* Experience participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results
* Experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis
